thread:
maya (PM): heads-up — after yesterday's batching change some Dedicated tenants saw embedding timeouts. customer asks for short ETA. can we triage and pick mitigation? cc @aj @tom

aj (Eng Lead): on it. need logs & repro dataset. if it's strictly batch-size related we can put a soft cap quickly.

tom (SRE): pulled logs -> timeouts spike when batch_size > 8. example error: ```ERROR embed-service request_id=abc123 timeout=95s batch_size=16``` repro in staging with customer corpus.

rachel (Design): also hearing customers request better search recall — that's obviously an enhancement not a hotfix.

lee (Customer Success): customer-B (Dedicated) flagged SLA violations. they want immediate mitigation and a follow-up roadmap item.

maya (PM): options: 1) revert batching change (bigger blast radius) 2) enforce per-tenant batch cap (quick) 3) longer-term tuning/quantization/kv-cache work (epic). recommend 2 for now.

aj (Eng Lead): I can add a per-tenant default cap feature-flag. ETA ~60–90m to PR + CI. then deploy to Dedicated regions.

tom (SRE): I'll wire infra controls (rate limits + flag rollout) once PR is green. also will set monitoring alerts for p95/p99.

lee (Customer Success): customer-B prefers mitigation 2. please provide ETA so I can message them.

maya (PM): agreeable. rachel will draft customer note. we'll also create a backlog epic "Embeddings robustness" and assign owners.

rachel (Design): drafting comms now — short note + what we're doing next. will include expected ETA and next steps.

aj (Eng Lead): PR link: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/438 (adds per-tenant batch cap + flag). requesting @tom review.

tom (SRE): quick staging test: batch=16 -> 95s, batch=8 -> 23s. cap at 8 looks safe. approving PR.

maya (PM): plan: merge + canary to us-west by EOD, then roll to other Dedicated regions if stable. create ticket RDW-333 for epic with tuning work. owners: aj (implement), tom (monitor), rachel (comm), maya (PM).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1771112320. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng Lead): merged & kicking canary at 1771112320.

tom (SRE): canary healthy at +10m. p50/p95 stable, no timeout errors in sample tenant.

lee (Customer Success): customer-B confirmed SLA metrics improved after cap. please keep me posted on roadmap ETA.

aj (Eng Lead): next steps: add smaller experiments to RDW-333 — kv-cache sizing, quantization profiles, evals for recall. I'll sketch spec.

maya (PM): good. we'll review RDW-333 in next grooming and decide priority vs cost. for now mitigation stays in place until we ship a robust fix.

rachel (Design): will also propose a tenant-level override UI for support to temporarily adjust caps for specific customers (needs security/guardrails).

maya (PM): closing notes: hotpatch = per-tenant batch cap; short-term mitigation rolled; backlog epic RDW-333 created for robustness work; comms drafted. thanks team.

(footnote: root 1771112222, canary 1771112320, last follow-ups through 1771112400)
